The '''Imperial District''' was the area of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]] reserved for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], consisting of the northernmost plateau in the city. During the [[Invasion of Voss]] in [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by the [[Eternal Fleet]] completely eradicated the district, reducing the top section of the plateau to rubble.
